companyDescription: Single-asset biotech, now commercial-stage · ISEMBYLD (apitegromab-mstn) — first and only muscle-targeted treatment for SMA, FDA-approved Sep 11, 2026
priceNote: Live $48.00 on Nov 11, 2026. The prior report (Oct 26) used $41.71, a +15.1% drift. The Q3 print (Nov 10) has resolved; shares fell ~3% on the revenue miss.
summary: RESOLVED (Q3, Nov 10) — first ISEMBYLD sales of $0.57M missed the ~$1.43M consensus (the stock fell ~3%), though launch was only weeks old: approval came Sep 11 and first infusions in October. EPS of -$0.81 beat -$0.84. Cash is $413.6M plus $205M from the priority-review-voucher sale. The launch-ramp thesis is intact but now undated (next read: Q4 results, ~Mar 2027; EMA decision pending). Consensus ~$70 implies ~+47%. With no dated catalyst left, the report goes post-stage. Core Base bias +23.7pp vs realized 14d P75 +6.6%, so Base is a multi-week horizon, not a 14-day call.
risks: First-quarter launch numbers are usually small and noisy — easy to disappoint.
Payer access and reimbursement for a premium-priced add-on SMA therapy.
Manufacturing scale-up (a past CRL issue) remains a watch item.
EU approval timing after the resubmission.
Competition from established SMA therapies (Spinraza, Evrysdi, Zolgensma).

macroRisk.rateOutlook: The Fed held at 3.75–4.00% on Oct 28. After the hot Oct CPI on Nov 10, CME FedWatch prices a +25bp hike at the Dec 9 FOMC at ~89–100%, with ~10% odds of 50bp. The 10-year is ~4.98%.
macroRisk.inflationNote: Oct CPI: headline +0.4% m/m, core +0.3% m/m vs 0.2% expected. Sep core PCE 3.1% y/y. Oct PCE (Nov 25) and Nov CPI (Dec 10) are next.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: Newly commercial rare-disease biotech; moderate rate sensitivity, launch execution dominates.
macroRisk.summary: MEDIUM — a 25bp December hike is priced after the hot CPI. The tails are a 50bp move or a hot Nov 25 PCE, both of which hit small caps first, so the dip entry is preferred.
